access.auth: none documented for public DOC 2.0 URL
access.payment: GDELT says released datasets are available without fee

last_smoke.note: The second bounded anonymous GET for Ethereum article discovery received HTTP 429. No retry was made. The exact operation must pass a future anonymous smoke before operational use.

access.qualification_scope: Official free terms support the data entitlement, but this environment's DOC endpoint response is currently rate-limited; no returned article data has been qualified.

use_policy.purpose: catalyst discovery lead only; not event verification
use_policy.primary_source_rule: Open the returned publisher URL and corroborate material claims from an official issuer, governance, regulator, or other primary record.
use_policy.source_independence: GDELT indexes third-party news sources. Multiple articles can be syndicated duplicates, and the index is not independent primary evidence.
use_policy.timestamps: Preserve GDELT seendate as index/article-seen metadata; actual event time and publisher publication/update time require separate verification.
use_policy.attribution: Cite the GDELT Project when using its data.

failure_handling.429_or_auth_or_payment: stop provider branch; no retry and no inferred zero
failure_handling.malformed_or_empty: preserve as malformed or zero results as appropriate; do not infer absence of event
